Permission preview

Security architecture

  • Supabase Auth for admin/customer identity.
  • Role-based access + Row Level Security for products, orders, customers and media.
  • Payment gateway secrets only on server-side Edge Functions.
  • Verify payment callbacks before marking an order paid.
  • Audit log for admin changes, deletes and exports.
  • Rate limiting, input validation and webhook signature verification.
  • Never store card numbers, CVV, banking passwords or OTPs.
Owner safety rule: if a user tries to open or change an area outside their assigned permission, the production system should block the action, create an audit event, and show the Owner a warning for review.

Recent security events
No static HTML can honestly guarantee “1000% security”. Production should enforce permissions in the database with RLS, use MFA for privileged accounts, and keep secret keys only on trusted server-side components.

Secure Admin Access

Owner, Supervisor and Staff should sign in with their own account. In production, Supabase Auth + MFA/OTP + server-side role checks decide what each person can see or change.

Owner approval flow: invite a supervisor/staff member by email, assign only the permissions they need, and revoke access later. The actual OTP and session must be handled by the authentication provider — never by this HTML.
